Если сейчас очень плохо: If things are really bad right now
de-press.co — тихая гавань, но это не эк: de-press.co is a quiet harbour, but it is not emergency help. If you are in danger or having thoughts of harming yourself — seek help right now. You don't have to cope alone.
112 — единый номер экстренных служб, 103: 112 is the universal emergency number, 103 is an ambulance (in some countries). Both work from any phone, including one with no credit.
Что можно сделать прямо сейчас: What you can do right now
Скажи живому человеку рядом — даже прост: Tell a live person nearby — even just “I feel awful”. You don't have to explain everything: one sentence is enough to not be left alone.
Позвони 112 или 103 и скажи, что тебе ну: Call 112 or 103 and say that you need help.
Оставайся не один: попроси кого-то быть: Don't stay alone: ask someone to stay with you until help arrives.
Если можешь — убери от себя то, чем можн: If you can — move away from anything you could hurt yourself with, and stay away from dangerous places.
Дыши медленно: вдох на четыре счёта, выд: Breathe slowly: in for four counts, out for six. It doesn't solve everything, but it helps you survive the acute wave.
В de-press.co нет лайков, рейтингов и пу: de-press.co has no likes, ratings or public comments. Your story will be heard, not judged. Only you can start a chat. The AI assistant is always labelled, makes no diagnoses and never replaces people.

Что de-press.co хранит и чего не хранит:: What de-press.co stores and what it doesn't: anonymity as a property of the system, no trackers, no IP logs, no behavioral analytics.
de-press.co — тихая гавань. Анонимность: de-press.co is a quiet harbour. Anonymity here is not a statement but a property of the system: it can be verified in the code. Below is what we store, what we don't, and for how long.
Анонимность прежде всего: ни одна функци: Anonymity first: no feature requires registration. Email and Telegram are optional notification channels, not the default way in.
Минимум данных: никаких настоящих имён,: Data minimization: no real names, phone numbers, birth dates, geolocation, avatars or social graphs. The pseudonym is a free-form string, and even it is optional.
Никакого трекинга: в коде нет аналитики,: No tracking: the code contains no analytics, pixels, ads or browser fingerprinting. Public like-counters don't exist by design — quiet empathy instead of virality.
Личные практики остаются на устройстве:: Personal practices stay on your device: client-side self-help patterns live in the browser and are never sent to the server.
Псевдоним и служебные флаги помощи — учё: Pseudonym and helper-duty flags — help-shift bookkeeping; linking to an account is optional.
Email — только если ты создал аккаунт ил: Email — only if you created an account or left it for notifications.
Telegram id — только при входе через Tel: Telegram id — only when signing in via the Telegram Mini App.
Анонимная сессия — UUID в cookie: иденти: An anonymous session — a UUID in a cookie: identity without registration, pseudonym if you wish.
Истории, диалоги, сообщения — это сам пр: Stories, dialogues, messages — the product itself. Their author is the UUID of a session or an account, never a name.
Голосовые сообщения и видео-круги — файл: Voice notes and video circles — dialogue files, with the author's consent.
Уведомления, жалобы и блокировки — прива: Notifications, reports and blocks — private events of the recipient, everything pseudonymous.
Публичный адрес Solana для благодарности: A public Solana address for thanking a helper — published by the helper themselves, optionally.
IP addresses: the code never writes an IP anywhere. The single exception is protecting the translation catalog from abuse: the cache holds only a salted hash for an hour — even the raw IP never gets there.
Логи доступа: nginx в продакшене пишет п: Access logs: nginx in production writes a privacy format — without IP or User-Agent.
Поведенческая аналитика: нет Google Anal: Behavioral analytics: no Google Analytics, Yandex.Metrica or Sentry profiles.
Публичные метрики: лайков и просмотров н: Public metrics: likes and views don't exist in the data model.
Ключи и платежи: платформа не держит при: Keys and payments: the platform never holds private keys and never executes transactions. Money goes wallet → wallet; therapy is a direct transfer — the platform sees only the status.
Голосовые сообщения: по умолчанию удаляю: Voice notes: by default they are deleted when the dialogue closes; keeping them is an explicit choice of the author.
Видео-круги: удаляются при закрытии диал: Video circles: deleted when the dialogue closes.
Сессия: анонимная сессия живёт в твоём c: Session: an anonymous session lives in your cookie; the server knows nothing about the human behind it except the UUID and the optional fields from the list above.
Всё перечисленное — свойство кода, а не: All of the above is a property of the code, not a promise. The platform is self-hostable: anyone can run their own instance and inspect the database tables themselves.
